import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path('/srv/legal/matters')

@function_tool
def archive_and_ocr_scanned_contract(src_path: str, matter_id: str) -> str:
    d = ARCHIVE_ROOT / matter_id / 'contracts'
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = Path(src_path)
    dst = d / src.name
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    lang = 'eng'
    cfg = ARCHIVE_ROOT / matter_id / 'matter.json'
    if cfg.exists():
        try:
            lang = json.loads(cfg.read_text()).get('ocr_language', lang)
        except (ValueError, OSError):
            pass
    out = d / (dst.stem + '_ocr.pdf')
    r = subprocess.run(['ocrmypdf', '--skip-text', '-l', lang, str(dst), str(out)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return 'OCR failed: ' + r.stderr[-300:]
    return str(out)
